name: Runaway Bay Sunday Challenge 2022
information: This is a series competition alongside [Runaway Bay Saturday Challenge 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RunawayBaySaturdayChallenge2022) . You will be permitted to compete at **ONLY ONE** of the two competitions. If you register for both, your registration will only be accepted for one of the competitions.
